pick.pickFirst: Pick an exam and a class

setup.title: Exam setup
setup.subtitle: The kinds of exam you hold, their usual max marks and their share of the year’s result.
setup.name: Exam type
setup.defaultMaxHint: Papers of this type start with this
setup.weightageHint: Used when exams are combined into a final result. 0 leaves it out (e.g. pre-boards).

setup.gradingHint: Grading scales (A1, A2 … or your own) are set in Academic setup › Grading schemes; each class uses its own, and an exam can override it.

schedule.title: Exam schedule
schedule.subtitle: Set up each exam: the classes in it, every paper’s date and time, and its marks.
schedule.name: Exam
schedule.gradingHint: Leave as it is to use each class’s own scheme
schedule.instructionsHint: e.g. Reach 15 minutes early. Bring your hall ticket and ID card.
schedule.emptyHint: Make one for each exam you hold — unit tests, half-yearly, annual.
schedule.missingHint: Every class needs its papers, and every paper a date, before the exam can be scheduled.
schedule.scheduledHint: The timetable is out: hall tickets can be printed and teachers can enter marks.

scheduleConfirm.title: Schedule {{name}}?
scheduleConfirm.message: The timetable is fixed, hall tickets can be printed, and teachers can start entering marks.

schedule.unscheduled: The exam is back in set-up.

papers.title: {{cls}} · {{exam}}
papers.emptyHint: Add the class’s subjects, then give each paper its date and time.
papers.subject: Subject
papers.gradeOnlyHint: Co-scholastic (art, sports …): a grade is entered, not marks, and it is left out of the total.
papers.clash: Two papers of this class overlap on the same day.

hallTickets.title: Hall tickets
hallTickets.subtitle: Each student’s admit card with their class’s timetable.

marks.title: Marks entry
marks.subtitle: Enter each paper’s marks for your classes, then lock them when they are final.
marks.subject: Subject
marks.empty: No mark sheets for you in this exam
marks.emptyHint: You see the subjects you teach (Academic setup › Teacher allocation) and the classes you are class teacher of.

unlockConfirm.title: Unlock these marks?
unlockConfirm.message: The teacher can change them again. The reason goes in the audit log.

blocked.PUBLISHED: The results of this exam are published, so the marks can’t change.
blocked.NO_PERMISSION: You can see these marks but not change them.
blocked.TOO_LATE: Marks entry for this paper has closed (Settings › Exams). Ask someone who can unlock marks.

marks.hint: {{filled}} of {{total}} done. Tick Absent for a student who missed the paper, Not taking for one who doesn’t study this subject.

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Totals, grades and rank for each class. Publish when every mark sheet is locked.

publishConfirm.title: Publish the results of {{name}}?
publishConfirm.message: Every class’s results are worked out and the marks are frozen. Report cards can then be sent to families.

unpublishConfirm.title: Unpublish {{name}}?
unpublishConfirm.message: Marks can be unlocked and changed again. Report cards already sent stay with the families.

results.publishedNote: Published by {{name}}, {{at}}. The marks are frozen.
results.provisional: Provisional: {{locked}} of {{total}} papers of this class are locked. The figures change until every sheet is locked and the results are published.
results.starNote: * marks of this paper are not locked yet.

reportCards.title: Report cards
reportCards.subtitle: Write the class teacher’s remarks, print the report cards and send them to families.
reportCards.notPublished: The results aren’t published yet: report cards print as PROVISIONAL and can’t be sent.

sendConfirm.title_one: Send the report card to {{count}} family?
sendConfirm.title_other: Send the report cards to {{count}} families?
sendConfirm.message: Each primary guardian is told the report card is ready, by the channels set in Notification rules › Results published.

resendConfirm.title: Send every report card of this class again?
